oldConclusion: Rear -X, GPIO +Y, top +Z required a reflection. The far edge was incorrectly called robot LEFT.

viewReview.method: Direct enlarged top-oblique locked V40 S01/S02 and manufacturer component-side orthographic drawing; actual STEP topology independently imported
viewReview.frontIdentification: Plate A dual-opening flange/front arms are toward lower-left. Rear single-opening flange is toward upper-right. Visible component faces establish view from above.
viewReview.screenCoordinates: x right, y down; qualitative signs only, not calibrated metric projection
viewReview.parityProof: Using screen y upward, forward=(-1,-1), robot-left=(1,-1) have positive 2D cross product. Viewed from above, +X cross +Y is +Z. The earlier far-edge +Y assignment would reverse this sign.
viewReview.correctedReading: Near/lower-right long board edge is robot LEFT +Y; far/upper-left GPIO long edge is robot RIGHT -Y in green S02.

sharedPanelApplicability: Printed green panel explicitly applies to Pi4/Pi5 but depicts Pi4 connector order. It supports board rearward bank/top/header side; official Pi5 drawing/STEP govern Pi5 Ethernet-vs-USB ordering. Do not copy Pi4 socket order to Pi5.

separateProxyDefect.reason: Accepted M5 Pi5 recipe places the larger lower-height Ethernet-shaped block at +Y beside GPIO; official Pi5 drawing/STEP put Ethernet at low Y and USB pairs toward GPIO high Y. This defect is not the cause of the reflection triple.
separateProxyDefect.remediation: Additive Pi5 instructional CAD revision preserves PCB/header/holes and other schematic groups; corrects only Ethernet and outer USB bank member Y placement at CAD authoring time.

sourceLimits: Shared printed board drawing states Pi4 or Pi5 and depicts the source installation; actual user revision/cooler remain unknown. This review is not board metrology. No approximate numeric dimensions are required for the signed direction check.
